newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves foreign investment worth $ 1.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: India approves foreign investment worth $ 1.0 bln.

text.p: India's Industry Ministry said on Monday it approved 156 proposals involving foreign direct investment worth 35.45 billion rupees ($ 1.0 billion).
Among the proposals approved was one by Australian India Resources N.L. to set up a subsidiary with an investment of $200 million to undertake mineral exploration, a ministry statement said.
It also approved a proposal of Bayer Industries Ltd to set up a wholly-owned unit to make engineering plastics.
The Bayer venture will have a foreign direct investment of 1.199 billion rupees ($33.6 million), the statement said.
